# Feature: Fix projects ↔ project_members RLS infinite recursion

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-10-16 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
Library / Saga list fails with `infinite recursion detected in policy for relation "projects"`. Break the circular RLS between `projects` SELECT (membership helper) and `project_members` SELECT (subquery on `projects`) while keeping owner-scoped / GM / active-member visibility.

## Preconditions
- Local Supabase (`sagatree-db`) running; authenticated user with GM projects (e.g. Dornhain).
- Policies from `001_initial` + `004_project_membership_security` still in effect for members SELECT.

## Happy Path
- [ ] Authenticated GM can `SELECT` own projects (`gm_user_id = auth.uid()`) without recursion error.
- [ ] Active project member can `SELECT` projects they belong to via `current_user_is_active_project_member`.
- [ ] Authenticated user can `SELECT` own `project_members` row and (as GM, via SECURITY DEFINER helper) other members of their projects.
- [ ] Library Sagas tab loads without `Failed to fetch GM projects: infinite recursion…`.

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Inactive / kicked membership does not grant project SELECT via membership path.
- [ ] Non-member cannot SELECT foreign projects.
- [ ] Helpers `current_user_is_active_project_member` and `is_project_gm` remain `SECURITY DEFINER` with fixed `search_path`.

## Regression
- [ ] GM insert/update/delete on `project_members` still requires GM ownership.
- [ ] `get_saga_overview` / world atlas path still resolves projects for members.

## Assumptions
- Fix is DB migration only; no frontend API change required.
- Ponytail: rewrite members SELECT policy + re-assert DEFINER helpers; no broader RLS redesign.

## Security Coverage
- B-01 / SC-01: membership and GM checks stay server-side; no client-elevated role.
- B-04: no secrets.
- SC-02/SC-03/SC-06: N/A — no new public API routes.
- Launch Checklist (SC): N/A — not a launch ticket.
- Helpers stay SECURITY DEFINER with `SET search_path = public, pg_temp` (no search_path injection).
